s0101.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on gengwu day Zhao Prefecture ten-thousand-household office established garrison-farm fields; agricultural tools, seed, and food were supplied.
s0101.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, on gengwu day Zhao Prefecture ten-thousand-household office established garrison-farm fields; agricultural tools, seed, and food were supplied.

s0102.literal: On xinwei day notes of one hundred eighteen thousand ingots were granted to various Tibetan relay stations.
s0102.idiomatic: On xinwei day notes of 118,000 ingots were granted to various Tibetan relay stations.

s0103.literal: Relay households in Gan and Su prefectures suffered famine; grain was granted in varying amounts.
s0103.idiomatic: Relay households in Gan and Su prefectures suffered famine; grain was granted in varying amounts.

s0104.literal: Prince Wanze was granted a seal.
s0104.idiomatic: Prince Wanze was granted a seal.

s0105.literal: On guiyou day an edict ordered officials of the tea and salt transport commission, note-treasury commission, and grain-transport waterway commission to continue serving three-year terms as before;
s0105.idiomatic: On guiyou day an edict ordered officials of the tea and salt transport commission, note-treasury commission, and grain-transport waterway commission to continue serving three-year terms as before;

s0106.literal: Officials in Yunnan and Fujian who completed their terms were given relay transport to return home.
s0106.idiomatic: Officials in Yunnan and Fujian who completed their terms were given relay transport to return home.

s0107.literal: On renwu day Saturn encroached upon Jing, and Venus encroached upon Yuhui.
s0107.idiomatic: On renwu day Saturn encroached upon Jing, and Venus encroached upon Yuhui.

s0108.literal: Land held by Bayan, Ashu, Alihaiya, and others in Jiangnan and concealed by powerful families was registered and ordered to pay field rent.
s0108.idiomatic: Land held by Bayan, Ashu, Alihaiya, and others in Jiangnan and concealed by powerful families was registered and ordered to pay field rent.

s0109.literal: River-and-lake tax officials with annual income of five hundred ingots were appointed by imperial decree.
s0109.idiomatic: River-and-lake tax officials with annual income of 500 ingots were appointed by imperial decree.

s0110.literal: One associate administrator each was added to Jiangxi and Henan provinces; Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan were appointed.
s0110.idiomatic: One associate administrator each was added to Jiangxi and Henan provinces; Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan were appointed.

s0111.literal: The heir apparent of Goryeo, Wang Yan, was appointed special advance and pillar of state, director with triple court honor, and chief of the Council of State Affairs.
s0111.idiomatic: The heir apparent of Goryeo, Wang Yan, was appointed special advance and pillar of state, director with triple court honor, and chief of the Council of State Affairs.

s0112.literal: On yiyou day fugitive soldiers from Yunnan Province were sent to garrison Yiqibusi; Huguang and Jiangxi provinces were ordered to choose pasture lands for summer-stationed troops.
s0112.idiomatic: On yiyou day fugitive soldiers from Yunnan Province were sent to garrison Yiqibusi; Huguang and Jiangxi provinces were ordered to choose pasture lands for summer-stationed troops.

s0113.literal: On bingxu day Yueleye Nu and others were dispatched as envoys to Ma'bar.
s0113.idiomatic: On bingxu day Yueleye Nu and others were dispatched as envoys to Ma'bar.

s0114.literal: On jichou day regional censorate surveillance censors were ordered to audit case documents at circuit-level inquiry offices; three hundred tiger-guard soldiers were sent to garrison Yingchang.
s0114.idiomatic: On jichou day regional censorate surveillance censors were ordered to audit case documents at circuit-level inquiry offices; 300 tiger-guard soldiers were sent to garrison Yingchang.

s0115.literal: Officials in charge of tax collection — wherever their departments had arrears — were not to receive promotion in rank.
s0115.idiomatic: Officials in charge of tax collection — wherever their departments had arrears — were not to receive promotion in rank.

s0116.literal: Bandits Chen Fei, Lei Tong, Lan Qing, and Xie Fa in Guangxi raided Zhao, Wu, Teng, Rong, and other prefectures; Huguang left vice chancellor Batu Maxin attacked and pacified them.
s0116.idiomatic: Bandits Chen Fei, Lei Tong, Lan Qing, and Xie Fa in Guangxi raided Zhao, Wu, Teng, Rong, and other prefectures; Huguang left vice chancellor Batu Maxin attacked and pacified them.

s0117.literal: On xinsi day garrison troops of the Guvch guard were granted more than thirty-nine thousand ingots of notes.
s0117.idiomatic: On xinsi day garrison troops of the Guvch guard were granted more than 39,000 ingots of notes.

s0118.literal: That month, locusts in Pingyang, Daming, Guide, and Zhending; floods in Zhangde, Zhending, Cao, and Bin prefectures; drought in Huaimeng, Daming, and Hejian; hail in Taiyuan and Huaimeng.
s0118.idiomatic: That month, locusts in Pingyang, Daming, Guide, and Zhending; floods in Zhangde, Zhending, Cao, and Bin prefectures; drought in Huaimeng, Daming, and Hejian; hail in Taiyuan and Huaimeng.

s0119.literal: Fujian and Guangxi's two Jiang circuits suffered famine; relief grain was granted in varying amounts.
s0119.idiomatic: Fujian and Guangxi's two Jiang circuits suffered famine; relief grain was granted in varying amounts.

s0120.literal: Eighth month, dingyou new moon: merchants on seagoing vessels were forbidden to take gold and silver overseas; all envoys to foreign countries were forbidden from engaging in trade.
s0120.idiomatic: Eighth month, dingyou new moon: merchants on seagoing vessels were forbidden to take gold and silver overseas; all envoys to foreign countries were forbidden from engaging in trade.

s0121.literal: On gengzi day the moon encroached upon Kang, and Venus encroached upon Xuanyuan.
s0121.idiomatic: On gengzi day the moon encroached upon Kang, and Venus encroached upon Xuanyuan.

s0122.literal: On renyin day the Jiangzhe branch secretariat was ordered to use fifty vessels and one thousand three hundred water workers to patrol the coast and suppress private salt.
s0122.idiomatic: On renyin day the Jiangzhe branch secretariat was ordered to use 50 vessels and 1,300 water workers to patrol the coast and suppress private salt.

s0123.literal: On guimao day the moon encroached upon Tianjiang.
s0123.idiomatic: On guimao day the moon encroached upon Tianjiang.

s0124.literal: On yisi day an edict ordered rewards for reporting and capturing bandits: fifty strings of notes for one robber, half for a thief, half again for the capturing officer — all levied on the criminal; where none could be levied, the government paid.
s0124.idiomatic: On yisi day an edict ordered rewards for reporting and capturing bandits: 50 strings of notes for one robber, half for a thief, half again for the capturing officer — all levied on the criminal; where none could be levied, the government paid.

s0125.literal: On yimao day the moon encroached upon Tianjie, and Venus encroached upon Shangjiang.
s0125.idiomatic: On yimao day the moon encroached upon Tianjie, and Venus encroached upon Shangjiang.

s0126.literal: Prince Yilinzhen's troops were granted three months' rations.
s0126.idiomatic: Prince Yilinzhen's troops were granted three months' rations.

s0127.literal: That month, locusts in Dezhou, Zhangde, and Taiyuan; frost killed crops in Xianning County, Jin and Fu prefectures, and Longxing Route; great rain in Ninghai Prefecture; flood in Daming Route.
s0127.idiomatic: That month, locusts in Dezhou, Zhangde, and Taiyuan; frost killed crops in Xianning County, Jin and Fu prefectures, and Longxing Route; great rain in Ninghai Prefecture; flood in Daming Route.

s0128.literal: Ninth month, wuchen day: Venus encroached upon Zuozhifa.
s0128.idiomatic: Ninth month, wuchen day: Venus encroached upon Zuozhifa.

s0129.literal: On xinwei day, the Birthday Festival: the Emperor halted at Antong Po and received congratulations from princes and officials.
s0129.idiomatic: On xinwei day, the Birthday Festival: the Emperor halted at Antong Po and received congratulations from princes and officials.

s0130.literal: On renshen day the moon masked Nandou.
s0130.idiomatic: On renshen day the moon masked Nandou.

s0131.literal: On jiaxu day salt prices were raised to sixty-five strings of notes per yin; salt-house production money to ten strings — Guangxi alone unchanged.
s0131.idiomatic: On jiaxu day salt prices were raised to 65 strings of notes per yin; salt-house production money to 10 strings — Guangxi alone unchanged.

s0132.literal: Summer tax was levied in eastern Zhejiang, Fujian, and Huguang.
s0132.idiomatic: Summer tax was levied in eastern Zhejiang, Fujian, and Huguang.

s0133.literal: Private salt and iron furnaces and kilns were abolished.
s0133.idiomatic: Private salt and iron furnaces and kilns were abolished.

s0134.literal: Qolula troops in Xiangyang Prefecture who had not yet received land grants were given two months' grain.
s0134.idiomatic: Qolula troops in Xiangyang Prefecture who had not yet received land grants were given two months' grain.

s0135.literal: Patrol, prohibition, and hunting personnel throughout Huai West were abolished.
s0135.idiomatic: Patrol, prohibition, and hunting personnel throughout Huai West were abolished.

s0136.literal: On dingchou day the moon encroached upon Leibizhen.
s0136.idiomatic: On dingchou day the moon encroached upon Leibizhen.

s0137.literal: On wuyin day bandit Shezi of Yuanjiang killed and plundered the frontier; the Prince of Liang ordered Qixiedan and others to campaign and receive his surrender.
s0137.idiomatic: On wuyin day bandit Shezi of Yuanjiang killed and plundered the frontier; the Prince of Liang ordered Qixiedan and others to campaign and receive his surrender.

s0138.literal: On jiashen day Yunnan provincial official Yesan Buqa campaigned against Qilan, captured Wanon and Kaiyang fortresses; his follower Dala led various tribal peoples to surrender; Qilan was entirely pacified and the territory made Yunyuan Route Military-Civilian General Commission.
s0138.idiomatic: On jiashen day Yunnan provincial official Yesan Buqa campaigned against Qilan, captured Wanon and Kaiyang fortresses; his follower Dala led various tribal peoples to surrender; Qilan was entirely pacified and the territory made Yunyuan Route Military-Civilian General Commission.

s0139.literal: On jichou day the moon encroached upon Xuanyuan.
s0139.idiomatic: On jichou day the moon encroached upon Xuanyuan.

s0140.literal: On xinmao day troops under Prince Chubo, Grand Commander Wang, and others were impoverished; because they had long garrisoned, the Emperor ordered five thousand to remain for winter garrison and the rest sent home, to rejoin the army in fourth month of the next year.
s0140.idiomatic: On xinmao day troops under Prince Chubo, Grand Commander Wang, and others were impoverished; because they had long garrisoned, the Emperor ordered 5,000 to remain for winter garrison and the rest sent home, to rejoin the army in fourth month of the next year.

s0141.literal: On jiawu day Guanghai and the Left and Right Two Rivers garrison troops were ordered to rotate garrison duty every two or three years;
s0141.idiomatic: On jiawu day Guanghai and the Left and Right Two Rivers garrison troops were ordered to rotate garrison duty every two or three years;

s0142.literal: Prince Ulus Buqa's division granted ten thousand shi of grain to Prince Chubo's troops.
s0142.idiomatic: Prince Ulus Buqa's division granted 10,000 shi of grain to Prince Chubo's troops.

s0143.literal: That month, flood in Yuanjiang County of Changde; its field rent was remitted.
s0143.idiomatic: That month, flood in Yuanjiang County of Changde; its field rent was remitted.

s0144.literal: Drought in Mo and Xian prefectures of Hejian.
s0144.idiomatic: Drought in Mo and Xian prefectures of Hejian.

s0145.literal: The Yellow River breached its banks in Qi, Fengqiu, Xiangfu, Ningling, and Xiangyi counties of Henan.
s0145.idiomatic: The Yellow River breached its banks in Qi, Fengqiu, Xiangfu, Ningling, and Xiangyi counties of Henan.

s0146.literal: Winter, tenth month, dingyou day: sacrifices were performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0146.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, dingyou day: sacrifices were performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0147.literal: On renyin day one hundred thousand shi of grain was issued for relief sale in the capital; palace guard horses were pastured at Xuande, Fengsheng, Huailai, Jinshan, and other places.
s0147.idiomatic: On renyin day 100,000 shi of grain was issued for relief sale in the capital; palace guard horses were pastured at Xuande, Fengsheng, Huailai, Jinshan, and other places.

s0148.literal: On jiachen day Dadu city walls were repaired.
s0148.idiomatic: On jiachen day Dadu city walls were repaired.

s0149.literal: On renzi day the imperial procession returned from Shangdu.
s0149.idiomatic: On renzi day the imperial procession returned from Shangdu.

s0150.literal: Officials guilty of embezzlement who, after judgment, reoffended had three grades added to the original punishment.
s0150.idiomatic: Officials guilty of embezzlement who, after judgment, reoffended had three grades added to the original punishment.

s0151.literal: Bandit Liu Liushi of Ganzhou raided Ji Prefecture; Jiangxi branch secretariat left vice chancellor Dong Shixuan campaigned and pacified him.
s0151.idiomatic: Bandit Liu Liushi of Ganzhou raided Ji Prefecture; Jiangxi branch secretariat left vice chancellor Dong Shixuan campaigned and pacified him.

s0152.literal: That month, flood in Guangbei garrison-farm and Wendeng of Ninghai.
s0152.idiomatic: That month, flood in Guangbei garrison-farm and Wendeng of Ninghai.

s0153.literal: Eleventh month, dingmao day: because Mang Cave chieftain Peng Anguo and his son had merit suppressing Prefect Tian, Anguo was granted a gold tally and his son made a tribal official.
s0153.idiomatic: Eleventh month, dingmao day: because Mang Cave chieftain Peng Anguo and his son had merit suppressing Prefect Tian, Anguo was granted a gold tally and his son made a tribal official.

s0154.literal: Damarla Iben Wang sent his son presenting sixteen elephants.
s0154.idiomatic: Damarla Iben Wang sent his son presenting 16 elephants.

s0155.literal: On wuchen day all Guangxi garrison troops were placed under the Two Rivers pacification commission commander-in-chief's headquarters.
s0155.idiomatic: On wuchen day all Guangxi garrison troops were placed under the Two Rivers pacification commission commander-in-chief's headquarters.

s0156.literal: On jisi day Ududai and others presented the translated 《Veritable Records of Taizong》, 《Xianzong》, and 《Shizu》; the Emperor said, "Hudurumishi was not born of Empress Zhaorui Shunsheng — why is she also called princess?
s0156.idiomatic: On jisi day Ududai and others presented the translated 《Veritable Records of Taizong》, 《Xianzong》, and 《Shizu》; the Emperor said, "Hudurumishi was not born of Empress Zhaorui Shunsheng — why is she also called princess?

s0157.literal: When Empress Shunsheng died, Yuzong had already returned from the army — the recorded dates of months and days were out of order.
s0157.idiomatic: When Empress Shunsheng died, Yuzong had already returned from the army — the recorded dates of months and days were out of order.

s0158.literal: Also, artilleryman Ismayin of Bielimasi Tan and the Quanfu Office — these are all minor matters; why record them?
s0158.idiomatic: Also, artilleryman Ismayin of Bielimasi Tan and the Quanfu Office — these are all minor matters; why record them?

s0159.literal: On xinwei day ten thousand Badu troops of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat were transferred to garrison Tan Prefecture; troops south of Tan Prefecture were moved to garrison Chen Prefecture.
s0159.idiomatic: On xinwei day 10,000 Badu troops of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat were transferred to garrison Tan Prefecture; troops south of Tan Prefecture were moved to garrison Chen Prefecture.

s0160.literal: Ten thousand garrison-farm troops from Hongze and Shaobo were used to repair Dadu city walls.
s0160.idiomatic: 10,000 garrison-farm troops from Hongze and Shaobo were used to repair Dadu city walls.

s0161.literal: Privy Council officials were dispatched to reorganize garrison troops at various Jiangnan posts; commanders' diligence and sloth were to be listed in full and reported.
s0161.idiomatic: Privy Council officials were dispatched to reorganize garrison troops at various Jiangnan posts; commanders' diligence and sloth were to be listed in full and reported.

s0162.literal: Next year's sea-transport grain quota was increased to six hundred thousand shi.
s0162.idiomatic: Next year's sea-transport grain quota was increased to 600,000 shi.

s0163.literal: On dingchou day the moon encroached upon Yue, and again encroached upon Tianjie.
s0163.idiomatic: On dingchou day the moon encroached upon Yue, and again encroached upon Tianjie.

s0164.literal: On gengchen day the moon encroached upon Jing.
s0164.idiomatic: On gengchen day the moon encroached upon Jing.

s0165.literal: On dinghai day the moon encroached upon Shangxiang.
s0165.idiomatic: On dinghai day the moon encroached upon Shangxiang.

s0166.literal: On yiyou day privy council officials said, "In Jiangnan's frontier prefectures and counties, strategic points should be chosen to combine scattered garrisons into one encampment — if emergency arises, troops can be mobilized easily.
s0166.idiomatic: On yiyou day privy council officials said, "In Jiangnan's frontier prefectures and counties, strategic points should be chosen to combine scattered garrisons into one encampment — if emergency arises, troops can be mobilized easily.

s0167.literal: An edict ordered the branch secretariat to map terrain and verify troop strength and report.
s0167.idiomatic: An edict ordered the branch secretariat to map terrain and verify troop strength and report.

s0168.literal: On wuzi day the moon encroached upon Pingdao.
s0168.idiomatic: On wuzi day the moon encroached upon Pingdao.

s0169.literal: Dadu patrol and defense Han troops were increased.
s0169.idiomatic: Dadu patrol and defense Han troops were increased.

s0170.literal: On renchen day the moon encroached upon Tianjiang.
s0170.idiomatic: On renchen day the moon encroached upon Tianjiang.

s0171.literal: The king of Burma sent his sons Sanghaba and Shusi Bangba to present tribute goods.
s0171.idiomatic: The king of Burma sent his sons Sanghaba and Shusi Bangba to present tribute goods.

s0172.literal: Boxing Prefecture of Yunnan was abolished and merged into Dechang Route; Court of Imperial Sacrifices ritual-music households were granted more than five thousand ingots of notes.
s0172.idiomatic: Boxing Prefecture of Yunnan was abolished and merged into Dechang Route; Court of Imperial Sacrifices ritual-music households were granted more than 5,000 ingots of notes.

s0173.literal: That month, flood at Xiangshi garrison-farm; its field rent was remitted.
s0173.idiomatic: That month, flood at Xiangshi garrison-farm; its field rent was remitted.

s0174.literal: Twelfth month, wuxu day: the Cheli Military-Civilian General Commission was established.
s0174.idiomatic: Twelfth month, wuxu day: the Cheli Military-Civilian General Commission was established.

s0175.literal: Yunnan branch secretariat officials said, "Great Cheli territory interlocks with Babai Xifu; now Great Cheli Hunian has submitted, but Lesser Cheli again seizes strategic terrain and there is much mutual killing and plunder.
s0175.idiomatic: Yunnan branch secretariat officials said, "Great Cheli territory interlocks with Babai Xifu; now Great Cheli Hunian has submitted, but Lesser Cheli again seizes strategic terrain and there is much mutual killing and plunder.

s0176.literal: Hunian sent his younger brother Hulun requesting a separate commission be established, with someone versed in tribal conditions appointed commander, to summon submission and use it as a base for advance.
s0176.idiomatic: Hunian sent his younger brother Hulun requesting a separate commission be established, with someone versed in tribal conditions appointed commander, to summon submission and use it as a base for advance.

s0177.literal: An edict ordered restoration of the Mengyang Gang and other district military-civilian officials.
s0177.idiomatic: An edict ordered restoration of the Mengyang Gang and other district military-civilian officials.

s0178.literal: On guimao day stipulations were set for gifts at princes' court audiences: line of Taizu — one thousand liang gold, seventy-five thousand liang silver;
s0178.idiomatic: On guimao day stipulations were set for gifts at princes' court audiences: line of Taizu — 1,000 liang gold, 75,000 liang silver;

s0179.literal: line of Shizu — five hundred liang gold each, twenty-five thousand liang silver each;
s0179.idiomatic: line of Shizu — 500 liang gold each, 25,000 liang silver each;

s0181.literal: On dingwei day the moon encroached upon Jing.
s0181.idiomatic: On dingwei day the moon encroached upon Jing.

s0182.literal: An edict ordered all branch secretariats to levy and replace deserters.
s0182.idiomatic: An edict ordered all branch secretariats to levy and replace deserters.

s0183.literal: Astronomical Bureau stargazer households were restored.
s0183.idiomatic: Astronomical Bureau stargazer households were restored.

s0184.literal: On yimao day the moon encroached upon Jinxian.
s0184.idiomatic: On yimao day the moon encroached upon Jinxian.

s0185.literal: On guihai day one hundred prisoners in the capital were released;
s0185.idiomatic: On guihai day 100 prisoners in the capital were released;

s0186.literal: two supervising censor posts were added;
s0186.idiomatic: two supervising censor posts were added;

s0187.literal: clothing was granted to tribute-bearers from Jinchi and Luohu.
s0187.idiomatic: clothing was granted to tribute-bearers from Jinchi and Luohu.

s0188.literal: That year, floods in Dadu, Baoding, Bianliang, Jiangling, Mianyang, and Huai'an; wind damaged crops in Jin and Fu prefectures; drought in Taiyuan, Kaiyuan, Henan, and Shaobo — field rents remitted.
s0188.idiomatic: That year, floods in Dadu, Baoding, Bianliang, Jiangling, Mianyang, and Huai'an; wind damaged crops in Jin and Fu prefectures; drought in Taiyuan, Kaiyuan, Henan, and Shaobo — field rents remitted.

s0189.literal: That year, twenty-four persons were sentenced to capital punishment.
s0189.idiomatic: That year, 24 persons were sentenced to capital punishment.

s0190.literal: Second month, jiawu new moon: Prince of Jin Gammala was granted seventy thousand ingots of notes, Prince of Anxi Ananda thirty thousand ingots.
s0190.idiomatic: Second month, jiawu new moon: Prince of Jin Gammala was granted 70,000 ingots of notes, Prince of Anxi Ananda 30,000 ingots.

s0191.literal: On bingshen day the chieftain of Mengyang district submitted allegiance, sent his younger brother Abula and others to present tribute and request annual tribute of one thousand liang silver and establishment of relay posts; an edict immediately established Tongxi Military-Civilian Prefecture there at rank four positive.
s0191.idiomatic: On bingshen day the chieftain of Mengyang district submitted allegiance, sent his younger brother Abula and others to present tribute and request annual tribute of 1,000 liang silver and establishment of relay posts; an edict immediately established Tongxi Military-Civilian Prefecture there at rank 4 positive.

s0192.literal: On wuxu day Quan Prefecture was promoted to Quanning Prefecture.
s0192.idiomatic: On wuxu day Quan Prefecture was promoted to Quanning Prefecture.

s0193.literal: On gengzi day an edict ordered Mongol garrison troops on eastern princes' allotments: dead replaced, those unable to bear corvée exchanged.
s0193.idiomatic: On gengzi day an edict ordered Mongol garrison troops on eastern princes' allotments: dead replaced, those unable to bear corvée exchanged.

s0194.literal: On guimao day Deng Xin's troops of Yangzhou ten-thousand-household office were relocated to garrison at Qi and Huang; newly submitted Goryeo, Jurchen, and Han troops under Chalitai were settled at Shen Prefecture.
s0194.idiomatic: On guimao day Deng Xin's troops of Yangzhou ten-thousand-household office were relocated to garrison at Qi and Huang; newly submitted Goryeo, Jurchen, and Han troops under Chalitai were settled at Shen Prefecture.

s0195.literal: On jiashen day in cases where military and civilian populations sued each other, military and civilian officials were ordered to hear them jointly.
s0195.idiomatic: On jiashen day in cases where military and civilian populations sued each other, military and civilian officials were ordered to hear them jointly.

s0196.literal: On dingwei day the hunting-and-falconry office was abolished and merged into Dongjing Route.
s0196.idiomatic: On dingwei day the hunting-and-falconry office was abolished and merged into Dongjing Route.

s0197.literal: On wuwu day the chieftain of Luoluo Si came to court.
s0197.idiomatic: On wuwu day the chieftain of Luoluo Si came to court.

s0198.literal: On jiwei day Fujian Province was changed to Fujian Pinghai and other places branch secretariat, with administration moved to Quanzhou.
s0198.idiomatic: On jiwei day Fujian Province was changed to Fujian Pinghai and other places branch secretariat, with administration moved to Quanzhou.

s0199.literal: Grand councillor Gao Xing said Quanzhou is near Liuqiu — with inducement or seizure, intelligence is easily obtained; hence the move.
s0199.idiomatic: Grand councillor Gao Xing said Quanzhou is near Liuqiu — with inducement or seizure, intelligence is easily obtained; hence the move.

s0200.literal: Fujian tribute-weaving commission annual plain silk was reduced by three thousand bolts; what was woven was given added brocade embroidery; annual tribute padded garments increased by two hundred; a separate tribute commission was established to manage chequ-band craftsmanship.
s0200.idiomatic: Fujian tribute-weaving commission annual plain silk was reduced by 3,000 bolts; what was woven was given added brocade embroidery; annual tribute padded garments increased by 200; a separate tribute commission was established to manage chequ-band craftsmanship.
